name: Custom Translation Deployments
description: Makes it possible to have custom translation files in a directory
project_description: Custom Translation Deployments lets you ship interface-translation .po files alongside your code and have Drupal's locale system import them automatically. It registers one or more synthetic "projects" with locale's project storage so that files matching a naming pattern (by default project_specific-custom.LANGUAGE.po) placed in the site's configured translations directory are picked up on a locale translation update, exactly like a contrib project's downloaded translations. A built-in default project (project_specific, version custom) works out of the box, and any module can expose additional file patterns via hook_custom_translation_deployments_files(). The intended workflow is to keep the .po files in version control and run drush locale:update as a deploy step, giving you repeatable, code-driven deployment of custom translation overrides across environments. The module has no admin UI, routes, permissions, services, or config of its own; all behaviour is driven by two Drupal locale hooks plus one info hook.
